intro.h2: Home remodeling in Kent, WA, from a small team that runs lean
paragraphs: Quality Performance Construction is a remodeling company in Kent, WA, run by Sam. We keep the operation small on purpose, and customers say Sam manages it well and cost-efficiently. Our work covers kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, flooring and the framing, drywall and siding repairs that come with a real home remodeling job.

Our reviews tell the story better than we can. One homeowner had us gut a den that used to be a garage, along with a half bath and laundry area, move a wall and open another for sliding glass doors to the patio. Another needed 60 bags of self-leveler before his 9 inch planks could go down. A third expected six days of work and got it done in four, with any unexpected work agreed in advance.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: New cabinets, counters, backsplashes and floors, planned around how you cook. The kitchen shown has gray shaker cabinets, white quartz counters and live-edge open shelves above a large-format plank tile floor. One customer had backsplashes installed by our team and says the project went smooth and clean.

image.alt: Kitchen with gray shaker cabinets, white quartz counters, stainless appliances and live-edge open shelves

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: From half baths to full bathrooms, we strip the room and rebuild it. This powder room got a white shaker vanity with a quartz top, a round brass mirror, brass light and fixtures, walnut floating shelves and a painted plank ceiling. One customer's half bath was part of a larger gut and rebuild.

image.alt: Powder room with a white shaker vanity, round brass mirror, brass fixtures, walnut shelves and a painted plank ceiling

items.name: Flooring installation
items.blurb: Floors are only as good as what is under them. On one job the subfloor needed 60 bags of self-leveling compound before we laid 9 inch planks, and the homeowner says every part of the project went smooth and was clean. We install wide plank flooring through basements, bedrooms and open living areas.

image.alt: Large open basement with newly installed light oak-look wide plank flooring, white columns and recessed lights

items.name: Room remodels, walls and doors
items.blurb: Need a room rearranged? We have gutted a den that started life as a garage, moved a wall, closed off a door and opened a wall for sliding glass doors to the patio. Sliding glass doors come up in our reviews, along with work done quickly and on budget.

image.alt: Remodeled den with gray walls, recessed lights, wood-look plank floor and new sliding glass doors being finished

items.name: Laundry rooms
items.blurb: Laundry areas deserve a plan too. This one has a stacked-height counter over side-by-side front loaders, dark floating shelves, a painted plank ceiling and wood-look floor. A laundry area was one piece of a larger remodel where one customer says Sam listened to what she wanted.

image.alt: Laundry nook with a white counter over front-load washer and dryer, dark floating shelves and a painted plank ceiling

items.name: Siding, framing and exterior repairs
items.blurb: We also work on the outside of the house. For one homeowner we removed an unused balcony, replaced a sliding door with a window, framed inside and out, handled drywall and paint, and replaced and painted damaged siding. He is hiring us again for trim around his garage doors.

items.title: On budget, on schedule
items.text: One homeowner says Sam finished on budget and well within the timeline he first estimated. Budget and quick work are among the most-mentioned topics in our Google reviews.

items.title: No surprise charges
items.text: Any additional unexpected work is discussed and agreed to in advance, as one repeat customer points out. He calls Sam honest and trustworthy.

items.title: Fast without cutting corners
items.text: We finished in four days what one customer expected would take at least six: a balcony removed, a door swapped for a window, framing, drywall, paint and siding.

items.title: A small team, well run
items.text: One customer was nervous about hiring a young contractor with a small operation and says she is so glad she did. Sam knew what he was doing and ran it cost-efficiently.

about.text: Quality Performance Construction is Sam's remodeling company, based at 3640 S 272nd St in Kent, WA. Sam manages the projects and keeps a small, skilled team, which customers say helps him work cost-efficiently. He listens to what you want, gives you a timeline up front and talks through any extra work before it happens. Our projects run from garage-turned-den remodels and powder rooms to whole basements of new plank flooring. We are open weekdays from 8 AM to 8 PM and Saturdays from 9 AM to 4 PM.
about.owner_role: Named in every captured review as the person who runs and manages the projects; last name and title not stated on Google

process.h2: How a remodel with Sam works

steps.title: Tell us what you want
steps.text: Call (206) 755-1423 and describe your project. Sam listens to what you are looking for before suggesting anything.

steps.title: Estimate and timeline
steps.text: You get a budget and an estimated timeline before work starts, so you can plan around the project.

steps.title: Demo and rebuild
steps.text: We gut, frame, level, drywall and finish, keeping the job clean and moving quickly without cutting corners.

steps.title: Changes agreed first
steps.text: If something unexpected turns up, we discuss it and agree on it with you before doing the extra work.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk the finished space together so you can check the details before we call the job done.

items.name: Laurel W.
items.text: Sam and his team did an incredible job, on budget (within reason) and well within the timeline he originally estimated.  He listened to what I was looking for and committed to impress - which he did.  The project involved completely gutting a large den (which had previously been converted from the original garage), half bath, and laundry area, redoing all of the floors and walls, moving a wall, closing a door, opening up a wall to put in sliding glass doors to the patio.  I was nervous about picking a contractor and was initially hesitant about Sam since he seemed young and has a small operation, but I am so glad we went with him.  He absolutely knew what he was doing and managed the small operation well and cost-efficiently!

items.name: Dean O.
items.text: Sam and his team at Quality Performance Construction are committed to excellent work and equally excellent customer service. They work quickly and efficiently, without cutting corners or compromising quality. They accomplished in four days, what I expected would take at least six: removing an unused balcony; replacing a sliding glass door with a window, including interior and exterior framing, drywall work and painting; and removing, replacing, and painting damaged siding. Any additional unexpected work is discussed and agreed to in advance. I am hiring them again to replace trim around our garage doors. Sam is honest and trustworthy.

items.name: Daniel M.
items.text: Sam did a great job managing my project! He installed some nice 9” planks in my home and had some backsplashes installed and it looks great! The flooring took 60 bags of self leveling but every part of the project went smooth and was clean. I will definitely keep using him for future projects.

service_area.text: Quality Performance Construction is based at 3640 S 272nd St in Kent, WA 98032. We take on remodeling, flooring and repair projects for homeowners in Kent. If you live nearby and want to know whether we can take your project, call (206) 755-1423. We answer weekdays from 8 AM to 8 PM and Saturdays from 9 AM to 4 PM, so an after-work call is fine.

items.q: What kinds of remodeling do you do?
items.a: We remodel kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and dens, install plank flooring and backsplashes, and handle framing, drywall, paint, doors, windows and siding. One project combined a garage-turned-den, a half bath and a laundry area with a wall moved and sliding doors added.

We give you a budget and timeline before we start, and budget is one of the most-mentioned topics in our reviews. One homeowner says Sam came in on budget, within reason, and well within his original timeline. If unexpected work comes up, we agree on it with you first.

It depends on the scope. One customer expected his project to take at least six days, and we finished in four: removing a balcony, swapping a sliding door for a window, framing, drywall, painting and siding. Quick work is a common theme in our Google reviews.

items.q: Can you install flooring over an uneven subfloor?
items.a: Yes. Leveling comes first. On one job the floor took 60 bags of self-leveling compound before we installed 9 inch planks, and the homeowner says the project went smooth and stayed clean. If you have noticed dips or soft spots, point them out and we will look at the subfloor with you.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 8 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 4 PM, closed Sunday. Call (206) 755-1423 or email qualityperformanceconstruction@gmail.com with a few photos and a short description of your project. Evening calls are welcome on weekdays.
